Title: integer binding
Code: let x: i32 = 42;
Explain: Binds integer 42 to x with explicit i32 type.

Title: mutable string
Code:
let mut name = String::from("Rust");
name.push_str(" lang");
Explain: Creates a mutable String and appends to it.

Title: boolean expression
Code: let is_valid = x > 0 && x < 100;
Explain: Binds a boolean from a compound comparison.

Title: tuple destructure
Code:
let (a, b, c) = (1, 2.0, "three");
println!("{a} {b} {c}");
Explain: Destructures a tuple into three bindings and prints them.

Title: array slice
Code:
let nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
let mid = &nums[1..4];
Explain: Creates an array and takes a slice of elements 1 through 3.

Title: simple add function
Explain: Defines a function returning the sum of two integers.
Rust functions return the last expression without semicolon.

Title: basic match on integer
Explain: Match expression with range pattern and wildcard arm.

Title: if let option
Explain: Uses if let to unwrap an Option with a fallback branch.

Title: for loop with range
Explain: Sums integers in an inclusive range using a mutable accumulator.

Title: string reference parameter
Explain: Returns a slice of the first word by scanning for a space byte.

Title: vector filter and collect
Explain: Filters even numbers from a slice using iterator adaptors.
Double reference in filter closure comes from iter() on a slice.

Title: option chaining with map
Explain: Chains parse into Option via ok(), then doubles with map.

Title: while let with pop
Explain: Drains a vector stack, summing only positive values.

Title: enum with data
Explain: Defines a data-carrying enum and computes area via pattern match.

Title: result with question mark
Explain: Uses the ? operator to propagate IO errors concisely.

Title: struct with impl methods
Explain: Defines a Counter struct with constructor and methods.
Self is an alias for the implementing type.

Title: iterator chain with fold
Explain: Chains iterator adaptors to extract cleaned words with their lengths.

Title: hashmap word frequency
Explain: Builds a word frequency map using the entry API.
The * dereference lets us modify the value in-place.

Title: implement Display trait
Explain: Implements Display to customize how Point prints.
The {:.2} format specifier rounds to two decimal places.

Title: custom iterator
Explain: Implements Iterator for an infinite Fibonacci sequence.
Associated type Item defines what next() yields.

Title: generic min function with trait bound
Explain: A generic function constrained by PartialOrd works for ints, floats, and strs.

Title: enum with nested match
Explain: Recursive evaluation of a boxed expression tree.
Box enables recursive enum variants by providing heap indirection.

Title: trait with default method
Explain: Trait with a default summarize method that delegates to required methods.
Implementors only need to provide title and author.

Title: generic stack with peek
Explain: A generic stack wrapping Vec with standard push/pop/peek operations.
peek returns Option<&T> to avoid moving the value out.

Title: complex pattern matching on result
Explain: Custom error enum with From-like wrapping via map_err.
Each error variant is matched exhaustively in the caller.

Title: lifetime in struct and method
Explain: Struct borrowing a string slice with an explicit lifetime.
The overlaps method uses pointer equality to check same source.

Title: closure capturing and higher-order function
Explain: Applies a sequence of filter closures as a pipeline.
Box<dyn Fn> enables heterogeneous closure storage in a Vec.

Title: complex trait bounds with where clause
Explain: Generic parser with multiple trait bounds including on the associated Err type.
Where clause keeps the signature readable with complex bounds.

Title: builder pattern with chaining
Explain: Builder pattern consuming self for fluent chaining.
Each setter takes and returns ownership for ergonomic method chaining.

Title: impl trait in return position with closures
Explain: Demonstrates impl Trait in argument and return positions.
make_chain composes two closures into one, capturing both by move.

Title: recursive json-like value with nested matching
Explain: Navigates a JSON-like tree by path using nested pattern matching.
split_first decomposes the path slice for recursive descent.

Title: state machine with generic transitions
Explain: Typestate pattern encodes valid transitions at compile time.
Invalid transitions like idle.complete() are compilation errors.

Title: nested option/result chain with custom errors
Explain: Typed config lookup with precise error reporting at each failure point.
ok_or_else converts Option to Result with a lazily constructed error.
